text:
morgan: Quick heads-up — interviewing Casey (SWE backend) tomorrow 10:30 PT. Need a volunteer to open with a 5–7min welcome + logistics, and a debrief owner. Also can someone confirm rubric weighting for this level? Zoom room needed.

samir: I can do the welcome + set up the room. I'll join at 10:15 to test audio.

alex_chen: I can take debrief ownership. Quick q — are we using the new weighting for IC2 or the old one?

katie: For IC2 we adopted the hiring doc weights last month: tech 50, system design 30, collaboration 20. Scale is 10pts total (so tech = 5, system = 3, collab = 2). I'll paste the link in a sec.

maya_k: Candidate is remote. Please avoid whiteboard-only exercises; use shared doc or editor. Also reminder to mute calendar notifications and enable remote video-friendly prompts.

recruiter-bot: Invite updated — panel + candidate added. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/meet/abc123. Candidate timezone: EDT.

morgan: Thanks — alex as debrief owner, samir for welcome. @katie can you drop the rubric link and a 1-line example for "ownership" scoring? Also need 1 backup debriefer in case Alex gets pulled.

samir: I can be backup debrief owner.

alex_chen: Sounds good. One more ask — please add short interview notes to the candidate GH thread: `recruiting/candidates/casey-123` (just bullet points).

katie: Rubric link: https://docs.redwood.com/hiring/swe-ic2-rubric. Ownership example to paste: `Ownership = drove feature from spec to prod; gave clear roll-forward plan for bugs` — will add to doc now.

morgan: I'll update the calendar description with: "Welcome by Samir; Debrief owner Alex; Backup Samir; Zoom link attached." Also adding 10min buffer before next meeting. Thanks all :thumbsup:

alex_chen: Please aim to keep debrief <=15m.

morgan: Got it — see you tomorrow.
